title: 99 nights OP Script A lot of features
features:
Hello i have my 99 nights in the forest script
Drop a like if you liked it 

Features 
- Kill Aura - Auto attack nearby enemies
- Chop Aura - Auto chop trees
- Configurable aura radius
- Auto Food - Auto eat when hungry
- Auto Pickup - Auto collect selected items
- Auto Heal - Auto use MedKit/Bandage when low health
- Auto Upgrade Campfire - Auto bring fuel to campfire
- Auto Scrap - Auto collect scrap items
- Auto Cook - Auto cook food at campfire
- Item Counter - Display item counts
- Auto Rejoin - Auto rejoin if you die
- Instant Interaction - No hold time for interactions
- Auto Stun Deer - Auto stun deer with torch
- Item ESP - Show items with text labels
- Character ESP - Show enemies with text labels
- ESP Boxes - 3D boxes around characters
- ESP Health Bars - Health bars above characters
- ESP Tracers - Lines from player to targets
- Distance Display - Show distance in ESP text
- Configurable ESP distance
- Teleport to Campfire
- Teleport to Stronghold
- Teleport to Lost Children
- Teleport to Item Chests
- Auto-update lists
- Fly - Fly around the map (WASD + QE)
- Speed - Adjustable walk speed
- Noclip - Walk through walls
- Infinite Jump - No jump cooldown
- Disable Fog
- Disable Night Campfire Effect
- Fullbright - Full lighting
- Bring Items - Auto collect items
- Bring Fuel - Auto collect fuel for campfire
- Bring Food - Auto collect food
- Bring Medicine - Auto collect medical items
- Bring Equipment - Auto collect equipment
- 6 Themes (Dark, Light, Gray, Blue, Green, Purple)
- Transparency toggle
- Resizable window
- Notifications
- Modern interface

Made with ❤️ by Jatrogzz
